rear view · numbers moulded on the socket
rear view · numbers moulded on the socket
input leads 30 cm (supplied), soldered to the SP21 cups
SP1312/S2 · wall socket, beacon cord plugs in outside
STARLINK_13V · converter input lead 30 cm (supplied), soldered to the cup
captive coax from the lid dome · connect last
57 V · supplied lead + barrel plug (98 cm)
Starlink cable, moulded plug · through the Ø63.4 cut-out before the grommet closes
CAT6A outdoor 10 ft, moulded RJ45 · to the cab switch
data — Starlink dish / LAN, moulded cables
SP13 4-pin pin 1 (ES_RX) and the receiver RED lead are live with the kit master switch OFF.
The feed comes from the enclosure safety chain, upstream of the master relay.
No junction blocks: converter leads solder straight to the SP21 cups, the beacon feed passes through untapped · every wall socket is a Weipu panel socket with its back nut inside
Wire table: roof-harness-definition.md (2026-09-01) · dish and LAN plugs are moulded, never cut · connect the dome lead only after the dome is bolted to the lid and the receiver is on its bracket
